name: Qatar Aluminium Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatar Aluminium Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C., through its subsidiaries, engages in the processing, manufacture, and sale of aluminum products in Qatar. The company offers extrusion ingots and primary foundry alloys that are used in the automotive, construction, and engineering industries, as well as in the manufacturing of consumer goods. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Doha, Qatar. Qatar Aluminium Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Qatar Energy.
